newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soybeans rally late on wheat/fund buying.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soybeans rally late on wheat/fund buying.

text.p: CBOT soybean futures rallied late on a surge in wheat futures and on fund buying, traders said.
"It was late fund buying and short covering and big volume," a trader said.
Traders said the surprising turnaround to strong levels in the wheat pit triggered the short covering in other pits, especially in soybeans and soymeal.
Griffin Trading, Merrill Lynch Futures, Refco Inc and Rosenthal Collins eachh bought one million bushels of March.
Soybeans closed 11 cents higher to 1/2 lower, with March up 11 at $7.51 per bushel.
